name: Cupcake
summary: Cupcake with swirled frosting, sprinkles and a cherry in a ribbed paper case, for party, dessert and sweets scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cupcake rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~340 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: frosting
params.note: frosting colour, e.g. pink, white #FFFFFF, chocolate #5E3B26, mint #8FD8C4

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
